description:
Engineering · Full-time · On-site, San Francisco · Salary: $180K - $325K + meaningful ownership of equity


ABOUT ERAGON

Eragon is an Applied AI lab building an AI platform that powers proactive agents for sovereign enterprises. We're working on memory, model routing, continual learning, and product experience that make agents useful, reliable, and governable in real-world settings.

We've raised more than $26 million in seed funding from investors including Khosla Ventures, a16z, Soma Capital, and Long Journey Ventures. We work with customers including Deel, Slash, Prodware, and Corgi to power their AI-native workflows.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Member of Technical Staff, you'll build the platform that makes Eragon's agents useful, reliable, and self-improving—from execution and tool use to memory, runtime, and the interfaces customers use every day.

The people who do well here like ambiguous, high-impact problems, move easily between research and production, and care about shipping things customers rely on. Depending on your strengths and the team's needs, you may focus on product, infrastructure, or research—or move between them.


IDEALLY, YOU'D HAVE

Experience from one of these areas:

 1. Product engineers who've owned features end to end at a fast-growing startup

 2. Infrastructure or platform engineers who've built reliable systems and want to work closer to the product

 3. AI builders who've taken LLM-powered systems from prototype to production, including tool use, context, and evals

 4. Researchers who've worked on agent trajectories, model routing, or self-improving systems and want to see that work in production


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Build the Agent Platform: Design, build, and run features across the agent lifecycle—execution, tool use, memory, and runtime

 - Design How Agents Work: Design how agents use context, models, tools, and connected business systems to complete real tasks, then keep making it better

 - Push the Research Forward: Research agent trajectories, model routing, and self-improvement, and turn what you find into product capabilities

 - Ship Dependable Systems: Build for reliability, observability, security, and clear user control

 - Solve Real Customer Problems: Work with design and deployment teammates to turn customer needs into shipped product


REQUIREMENTS

Must haves

 - Engineering Craft: Strong fundamentals and a record of shipping production software

 - Range: Comfortable working across systems and product surfaces and making pragmatic tradeoffs

 - AI Fluency: Hands-on experience with AI or agent systems and a drive to make them reliable and useful

 - Ownership: Clear communicator who works through ambiguity without waiting to be told what to do

Nice to haves

 - TypeScript/Node.js experience

 - Experience with enterprise software, integrations, or evaluation systems

 - Published research or open-source work on agents, routing, or continual learning

Equal opportunity: Eragon is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities and want everyone here to do their best work as themselves.

Accommodations: If you need support or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, let us know and we'll be glad to help.
